kebab_example: aliyun drds create-drds-instance --description This_is_a_test_instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-e --type PRIVATE --quantity 1 --instance-series drds.sn2.4c16g --specification drds.sn2.4c8g.8C16G --pay-type drdsPre --vpc-id vpc-en23cxsel1 --vswitch-id vsw-ewk32dsk --is-ha false --pricing-cycle month --duration 5 --is-auto-renew true --client-token DEWCEWQA --api-version 2017-10-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDrdsInstance

parameters.help_en:
The instance type. Valid values:

PRIVATE: dedicated instance
PUBLIC: shared instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例类型，取值：

PRIVATE：专享实例
PUBLIC：共享实例
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The number of instances to purchase
parameters.name: quantity

parameters.help_en:
The instance series. Valid values:

Entry Edition: drds.sn2.4c8g
Standard Edition: drds.sn2.8c16g
Enterprise Edition: drds.sn2.16c32g
Ultimate Edition: drds.sn2.32c64g
parameters.help_zh:
实例类型，取值如下：

入门版：drds.sn2.4c8g
标准版：drds.sn2.8c16g
企业版：drds.sn2.16c32g
至尊版：drds.sn2.32c64g
parameters.name: instance_series

parameters.help_en: The instance specification, which consists of the instance edition (such as drds.sn2.4c8g) and the specific instance specification (such as 8C16G)
parameters.help_zh: 实例规格，由实例系列（如drds.sn2.4c8g）加上具体的实例规格（如8C16G）组成。
parameters.name: specification

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

drdsPost: pay-as-you-go
drdsPre: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型。取值：

drdsPost：后付费
drdsPre：预付费
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The virtual private cloud (VPC) ID.

This parameter is required when you create a VPC-type instance
parameters.help_zh:
虚拟专用网络ID。

创建VPC网络类型的实例时必须指定
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The vSwitch ID.

This parameter is required when you create a VPC-type instance
parameters.help_zh:
虚拟交换机ID。

创建VPC网络类型的实例时必须指定
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the instance is a high-availability instance
parameters.name: is_ha

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription period. Valid values:

year
month
This parameter takes effect only when PayType is set to drdsPre
parameters.help_zh:
订购的周期单位。取值：

year
month
付费类型是drdsPre时参数生效
parameters.name: pricing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
The number of subscription periods.

If PricingCycle is set to year, valid values are 1 to 3.
If PricingCycle is set to month, valid values are 1 to 9.

This parameter takes effect only when PayType is set to drdsPre
parameters.help_zh:
订购的周期数量 。

PricingCycle=year时，取值1~3；
PricingCycle=month时，取值1~9。

付费类型是drdsPre时参数生效
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

true: enabled.
false: disabled.

This parameter takes effect only when PayType is set to drdsPre
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动续费，取值：

true：是
false：否

付费类型是drdsPre时参数生效
parameters.name: is_auto_renew

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to create the instance
parameters.name: client_token

Data.description_en: The result of the instance creation
Data.description_zh: 返回的创建实例结果信息

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
